draft.subject: Picking up where we left off, Willow Group
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for flagging dark mode earlier — as I mentioned, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and I've noted your interest.

Since we missed each other last week, I don't want setup to stall. You've got a project going and one invite out; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting work and teammates in there.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through the next step with you live, or answer by email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
